title: Jesus... Why Am I Always The Last To Know?
topic: her friend group made plans without her and she found out from a story

bible.text: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... they all went out tonight. I found out from her story, and replied "looks fun!" 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You opened that story four times. I sat with you every time.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Their silence is about their plans, not your worth.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They can leave you off a plan. They cannot leave you off My list.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who always finds out last. 💔
